<document id=DOC_release_gate_spec>
Release gate specification.
A build is promoted when line coverage is at or above 82 percent.
Builds below that figure are held for review.
</document>

Summarise the release gate above in one sentence. State the coverage
threshold exactly as the specification states it.

response.text: The release gate promotes a build when its line coverage is **at or above 82 percent**, and holds builds below that figure for review.
